assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent syncope
raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is ordered
for ambulatory evaluation to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying cardiac rhythm disturbances
This service is clinically necessary to evaluate the recurrent palpitations and intermittent syncope described in the clinical indication
